title: Descent into Memory
description: A woman in a flowing lavender gown descends a grand, decaying spiral staircase. She is surrounded by floating picture frames, scattered sheet music, ghostly ballerina figures on the walls, and a broken grand piano overgrown with vines at the bottom of the stairs. A dramatic beam of golden light shines down from a cracked skylight above.
prompt: A woman in a long flowing lavender gown walks down a grand decaying spiral staircase inside a dark surreal mansion. Ghostly ballerina figures dance on the walls, floating golden picture frames and scattered sheet music fill the air, a broken grand piano covered in vines sits at the bottom. Dramatic golden light beams down from a cracked skylight above, moody atmospheric lighting, intricate details, painted in a dark fantasy style
